fieldValues.title: RFC-056: Discovery filters on a record's own field values
fieldValues.author: agent:rfc-drafter (draft); the owner accepted it 2026-11-22 on the-greenman/srs#1044
fieldValues.affected_components:
`DiscoveryQuery` gains `fieldFilters` (`discovery.json`, and the inline copy in `composition.json`, kept identical by `check-discovery-query-defs-identical`); the mechanisms Field filters, Field filter values, Field filter comparison and Field filter refusals under the Discovery concept; a documented closure exclusion for `fieldFilters` (no metamodel change); a Door 3 revision row on RFC-012. Conformance fixtures land after srs-rust#1240, on a held branch. No stored shape changes, no `dataModelRevision` bump.

fieldValues.dependency_refs: Amends the surface of RFC-012 (Door 3). Builds on RFC-006 (Vocabulary resolution), RFC-032 (fieldType), RFC-039 (field values keyed by name), RFC-040 (effective field set). Follows whatever rule resolves a Type's fieldId (RFC-055, srs#1029, independent). Consults rfc-decision-cce3c00e, rfc-decision-9ee14517, rfc-decision-0750c62f, rfc-decision-4f1e12e5, rfc-decision-43249f53, rfc-decision-43e84d63, rfc-decision-2e0cd70a, rfc-decision-c20fcff8. Records its decisions as rfc-decision-91d52a0f, rfc-decision-6a49ce32 and rfc-decision-131f1448.
fieldValues.content: A `DiscoveryQuery` can select Tier 2 Records by their own field values through `fieldFilters`: each filter names a Field by id and tests it with `in`, `notIn`, `range` (date or numeric, inclusive) or `missing`, the tests allowed depending on the Field's datatype. Queries stay a flat conjunction. Invalid filters refuse the query; an unknown field id selects nothing with a warning. Full text: rfcs/rfc-056-discovery-field-filters.md.
